summary_1line: Abhimanyu battles Lakshmana and Kuru warriors until Arjuna intervenes, unleashing devastating arrows that rout the Kuru army before sunset.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and Krishna stand on their chariot as a storm of arrows darkens the sky, stopping elephants, horses, and kings advancing across the battlefield.
Young Abhimanyu and Lakshmana duel fiercely with bows, arrows flashing between them as surrounding warriors watch and shout.
The battlefield lies littered with broken chariots, severed weapons, fallen standards, and fleeing soldiers while Arjuna continues shooting with a fierce expression.
